CustomField.description: Percentage of an org limit (API requests, asynchronous Apex, platform events, data storage) at which AI Assist degrades: live push notifications stop (the chat window polls instead) and only errors are logged. Blank or outside 1 to 99 falls back to 70.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: At this percentage of an org limit AI Assist degrades: no live push, errors only logged. Default 70.
CustomField.label: Org Limit Degraded Percent
